newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares ease, PT and Telecom dominate.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares ease, PT and Telecom dominate.

text.p: 1810 GMT - Portuguese shares closed lower but losses were not as steep as on other European bourses. Further falls expected on Thursday.
*PSI20 index ended down 0.38 pct at 5,021.33 points.
*Telecel fell 194 escudos on foreign profit-taking to 9,306 after yesterday's surge with 751,415 shares traded.
*Portugal Telecom was down 43 to 4,310 on volume of 385,968.
*BTA was up 24 esc at 2,789 on turnover of 199,850.
